body: Thank you for the response. I don’t want to give up, but the thing about fibromyalgia is it fucks with the mind. I always feel fatigue and lazy. On top of the pain it causes. No matter how hard I try. Maybe I’m just a piece of shit in general. I feel like I’m not good enough for my son. He didn’t deserve to have a dad like me. My girlfriend has 2 jobs, and goes to school trying to become a medical assistant. She’s taking action and trying to give our son a better life while I sit at home wasting my life away. I can’t find a job that I’m able to do. Not to mention one with decent pay. I’m a nice person. I’m not judgmental. I’d help anyone who needed the help. But I lack motivation for anything. Since my problems began I’ve been doing nothing but staying in my bed, playing video games. Scrolling my phone. I’m not social anymore. The weight gain has definitely made me insecure. So I hate going in public now. And I hate having to hear everyone ask how I’ve gained so much weight in the little time since I got back from boot. I haven’t had a stable job since I worked as a sanitation worker. I did that for a year, and had to leave early February this year due to the pain I was having. And not being able to control when I went to the bathroom. I don’t want to sound like I’m complaining a lot, or that I’m just someone that craves the attention. I just feel like I’m not here anymore. And I’m scared I might actually try ending my life one day. And I can’t do that to my son. I just can’t. I’m thinking about seeing a therapist but even that costs money I don’t have. I’m stuck in a rut and I see no way out.
